title: 第23章 仇人相见再遇楚家爷孙第24章 这块金曜石是假的
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“是的，他就是我的夫君楚天铭。”
韩清雪落落大方的向着岳秋莹介绍道。
岳秋莹点了点头，随即看了眼楚天铭，道：“瞎子，你能娶到清雪，可是你上辈子修来的福气，你可要好好待她才是。”
“秋莹姑娘放心，我会保护好清雪，不让她受一点欺负的。”
楚天铭淡淡回道。
闻听此言，岳秋莹暗暗摇了摇头，心道你一个瞎子，能保护的了清雪才怪。
“秋莹丫头，时候不早了，可以带我们去寿宴了吧。”
韩正德微微笑道。
“韩叔说的是，请随我来，我这就带你们去宴席。”
岳秋莹轻轻一笑，然后拉着韩清雪的小手，向着映月楼的二楼走上去。
没过多久。
他们便来到了二楼。
二楼，乃是一个近百米方圆的大厅，宽敞大气，里面摆满了上百张的宴席，宾朋满座，十分热闹。
首席之上，则坐着一个穿着绸缎锦服，神态祥和的花甲老者。
此人，便是天河城的老城主岳崇山。
这位老城主不仅修为高深，而且在天河城内可谓是德高望重，即便是四大家族的家主对他都是恭敬有加。
而就在这老城主的身旁，还坐着几个他极为熟悉的身影。
李家家主，李斌，柳爷……还有楚狂和楚天骄！
看到二人的刹那，楚天铭眼睛里的金色光轮，便是不由的自转而起，双拳也是下意识的用力攥了攥。
不过很快。

他便压制住了内心的愤怒，脸色恢复了正常。
“爷爷，韩叔，他们来了。”
岳秋莹带着楚天铭等人，直接来到了老城主旁边的一处宴席上，然后向着老城主笑着说道。
“韩家家主，能来参加老朽的寿宴，老朽十分感激。”
老城主眯着双眼，笑呵呵的看向韩正德。
韩正德连忙回道：“老城主说笑了，您的寿宴，晚辈岂会不来？”
“哼，韩家家主，你来参加老城主的寿宴也就罢了，为何还要带来了一个被诅咒的人，岂会是给老城主增添晦气？”
就在这时，坐在一旁的楚天骄突然开口讥讽道。
韩正德斜眼看向他，道：“楚天骄，天铭好歹也是你的弟弟，你这么说他，是不是有些过分了。”
“可笑，他现在已经不是我们楚家的人了！”
楚天骄嘴角带着一抹嘲弄之色。
楚狂看了眼楚天铭一眼，却是什么也没有说。
韩正德冷哼一声：“好一个无情无义的楚家，连自己的血脉至亲都可以不认，当真是让我开了眼界，不过无所谓，你们不想要，我韩正德收下便是！
从今以后，天铭就是我韩家的人，谁若是再敢欺辱他，就别怪我不客气。”
话音落地。
韩正德身上立时散发出强大气势。
金丹境！
感受到韩正德体内散发出来的气息，众人脸色都是一变，谁也没有想到，韩正德修为，竟然已经踏入了金丹境界。
content_en:
"Yes, he is my husband Chu Tianming."
Han Qingxue introduced Yue Qiuying generously.
Yue Qiuying nodded, then glanced at Chu Tianming and said, "Blind man, you can marry Qingxue, but you have to treat her well because of the blessings you earned in your previous life."
"Don't worry, Miss Qiu Ying, I will protect Qingxue and prevent her from being bullied at all."
Chu Tianming replied calmly.
Hearing this, Yue Qiuying secretly shook her head and thought to herself, you are a blind man, it is strange that you can protect Qingxue.
"Girl Qiu Ying, it's getting late. You can take us to the birthday banquet."
Han Zhengde smiled slightly.
"Uncle Han said, please come with me, I will take you to the banquet right away."
Yue Qiuying smiled softly, then took Han Qingxue's little hand and walked up to the second floor of Yingyue Tower.
It didn't take long.
They came to the second floor.
On the second floor, there is a hall with a radius of nearly 100 meters. It is spacious and grand. It is filled with hundreds of banquet tables, full of guests and friends, and it is very lively.
Above the chief, there sat an old man in sixties wearing silk and brocade clothes with a peaceful expression.
This person is the old city lord of Tianhe City, Yue Chongshan.
This old city lord is not only highly cultivated, but also highly respected in Tianhe City. Even the heads of the four major families treat him with great respect.
And right next to the old city lord, there were still a few figures he was very familiar with.
The head of the Li family, Li Bin, Master Liu...and Chu Kuang and Chu Tianjiao!
The moment he saw the two of them, the golden halo in Chu Tianming's eyes couldn't help but spin, and his fists subconsciously clenched hard.
But soon.
He suppressed his inner anger and his expression returned to normal.
"Grandpa, Uncle Han, they are here."
Yue Qiuying took Chu Tianming and others directly to a banquet next to the old city lord, and then said with a smile to the old city lord.
"Head of the Han family, I am very grateful to be able to come to my birthday party."
The old city lord squinted his eyes and looked at Han Zhengde with a smile.
Han Zhengde hurriedly replied: "The old city lord is joking, how can this junior not come to your birthday banquet?"
"Hmph, Head of the Han family, you just came to attend the old city lord's birthday banquet. Why did you bring a cursed person? Will it bring bad luck to the old city lord?"
At this moment, Chu Tianjiao, who was sitting aside, suddenly spoke sarcastically.
Han Zhengde looked at him sideways and said, "Chu Tianjiao, Tianming is also your brother after all. Isn't it a bit too much for you to say that about him?"
"It's ridiculous, he is no longer a member of our Chu family!"
There was a hint of mockery in the corner of Chu Tianjiao's mouth.
Chu Kuang glanced at Chu Tianming, but said nothing.
Han Zhengde snorted coldly: "What a ruthless and unjust Chu family, they can even deny their own blood relatives. It really opened my eyes, but it doesn't matter, if you don't want it, I, Han Zhengde, will accept it!"
From now on, Tian Ming belongs to my Han family. If anyone dares to bully him again, don’t blame me for being rude. "
The words fell to the ground.
Han Zhengde immediately exuded a powerful aura.
Golden elixir realm!
Feeling the aura emanating from Han Zhengde's body, everyone's expressions changed. No one thought that Han Zhengde's cultivation had actually entered the realm of golden elixir.
